display.purpose: Playfair Display. Hero and feature moments and pull quotes only — reserved.

headline.purpose: Plus Jakarta Sans 600. Page H1s and section titles.

body.purpose: Roboto Slab. Long-form article prose at 1.8 line-height, 65ch measure.

label.purpose: Plus Jakarta Sans 600 uppercase 0.2em tracking. Deliberate, not on every section.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Cinematic spotlight for hero / signature moments only.

motion.name: ease-signature
motion.purpose: Default ease-out for state transitions, hovers, and reveals.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action — rose-coral pill with a tinted lift on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: #f43f5e; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.875rem 1.75rem; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 15px 30px rgba(244,63,94,0.25); transition: all 300ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.02); background: #fb7185; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(244,63,94,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(244,63,94,0.4); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action — ghosted outline that takes the accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: #f0f2f7; border: 1px solid #252a38; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.875rem 1.75rem; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 300ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #f43f5e; color: #f43f5e; background: rgba(244,63,94,0.1); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(244,63,94,0.3); }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Elevated content container — flat at rest, cinematic lift on hover.
components.html:
82% of Dentists Are Burning Out

The profession has a documentation problem — and the hours after the last patient leaves are where it hides.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #12161f; border: 1px solid #252a38; border-radius: 24px; padding: 2rem; transition: all 300ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); border-color: rgba(244,63,94,0.3); box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 0 40px rgba(244,63,94,0.1); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #f0f2f7; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-family: 'Roboto Slab', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #a0a8b8; }

components.name: Filter Pill (active)
components.description: Tag/filter pill in its selected state — rose fill, white text.
components.css: .ds-pill-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #f43f5e; border: 1px solid #f43f5e; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #fff; }

components.name: Filter Pill (interactive)
components.description: Unselected tag/filter pill — hairline outline that takes the accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #252a38; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #6b7a8a; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms; } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: #f43f5e; color: #f43f5e; background: rgba(244,63,94,0.1); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field on the surface tone with a rose focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #1a1f2b; border: 1px solid #252a38; border-radius: 12px; padding: 0.875rem 1rem; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #f0f2f7; transition: all 200ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8893a5; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #f43f5e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(244,63,94,0.15); }

components.name: Pull Quote
components.description: Signature editorial pull quote — centered Playfair framed by hairline rules.
components.html: When the last patient leaves, the dentist sits down — alone — and starts typing.
components.css: .ds-pullquote { margin: 2rem 0; padding: 2rem 0; border-top: 1px solid #252a38; border-bottom: 1px solid #252a38; font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 400; text-align: center; color: #f0f2f7; }

narrative.overview: A dark-first editorial system that reads like a well-set magazine shot under cinematic lighting. The default surface is a near-black blue-undertoned void, against which crisp cool-white text and a single rose-coral accent carry the page. Depth comes from soft, diffuse shadow and the occasional accent glow, not from heavy chrome. The personality is rigorous, grounded, assured: a practitioner's notebook with the production values of a print feature. Long-form reading is the product, so the type does the heavy lifting — Playfair Display for display moments, Roboto Slab for article bodies, Plus Jakarta Sans for interface and headings. It rejects the generic SaaS landing, corporate-healthcare sterility, and AI-slop sameness; the cream/paper editorial default is forbidden — the void IS the paper.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, with a fully-equal light theme (both clear WCAG 2.2 AA).
One accent voice: rose-coral, with warm amber as a rare secondary.
Serif display + serif reading body + sans interface — a tri-family editorial stack.
Cinematic depth: soft shadows and accent glow, never hard chrome.
Generous, fluid spacing and a 65ch reading measure.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Rose-coral is the only accent that speaks on its own. Amber may accompany it in a gradient, never replace it and never appear as a competing standalone color.

rules.name: The Void-Is-Paper Rule
rules.body: The reading surface is dark by default. A warm cream/sand/parchment background is forbidden. Warmth lives in the amber accent and the typography, never in the body background.

rules.name: The Reserved-Display Rule
rules.body: Playfair appears only where an editorial moment earns it. Default headings are Plus Jakarta Sans. Setting every heading in Playfair cheapens the display voice.

rules.name: The Earned-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: The uppercase tracked label is real but not scaffolding for every section. One named eyebrow where it carries meaning is voice; an eyebrow above every heading is AI grammar. Default to no eyebrow.

rules.name: The Diffuse-Glow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are large, soft, and low-opacity — cinematic ambient light, never a hard drop shadow. If the shadow has a visible hard edge or tight blur, widen the blur and lower the opacity.

dos: Do keep the void as the reading surface. Dark is the default; the light theme is a true near-white (#fafbfc), never a warm cream.
Do let rose-coral (#f43f5e) be the single accent voice, used sparingly so its appearances mean something.
Do set long-form body in Roboto Slab at 1.8 line-height, capped at 65ch.
Do reserve Playfair Display for display moments and pull quotes.
Do ease motion on cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) (ease-out), 200-300ms, with a prefers-reduced-motion alternative for every animation.
Do use large, diffuse, low-opacity shadows for cinematic depth.
donts: Don't ship a generic SaaS landing — no hero-metric template, no identical icon-heading-text card grids, no gradient-on-navy.
Don't drift into corporate-healthcare sterility — no clinical blue-and-white, no stock-photo-clinician tone.
Don't lean on AI-slop tells: no uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section, and never a cream/sand/parchment body background.
Don't use .gradient-text / background-clip: text for emphasis; use weight, size, or the solid accent instead.
Don't use a colored border-left greater than 1px as a side-stripe accent (the prose blockquote is the single allowed exception).
Don't reach for .glass-panel decoratively; blur/glass is rare and purposeful, or absent.
Don't set every heading in Playfair, or let amber compete with rose as a second standalone accent.
